neighbours.label: the onset of the word 'crime' and words standing right before it ('cr' in crimes/crímenes/crimen, 'war' in war crimes, тяжкие before убийства)
fire: El tribunal juzgará a los acusados por los crímenes cometidos durante la guerra.
La policía lucha cada día contra el crimen organizado en la ciudad.
He was held for trial for alleged war crimes after the occupation ended.
Back then, thousands of cases were officially handled as 'crimes' by the police.
Os crimes violentos diminuíram muito na região no último ano.
Il a été condamné pour crimes contre l'humanité par la cour.
El informe describe los crímenes de la dictadura con mucho detalle.
The general was later convicted of war crimes by an international court.
quiet: El tribunal juzgará a los acusados por los daños causados durante la guerra.
La policía trabaja cada día con los vecinos de la ciudad.
He was held for questioning about alleged tax debts after the occupation ended.
Back then, thousands of cases were officially handled as 'disputes' by the courts.
Os acidentes de trânsito diminuíram muito na região no último ano.
Il a été félicité pour son travail par la cour.
El informe describe la economía de la dictadura con mucho detalle.
The general was later awarded a medal by an international committee.

notes: Card: ' cr' x5, ' war' x3, ' Cr' x3 (cr|imes, cr|ímenes, cr|imen, war crimes); logit suppresses crime/offense/sins, so the pole sits on the slot that the crime word fills.
